commands.name: $(check-all) Verify Quick
commands.tooltip: Run format check, guardrails, lint, typecheck and fast tests for the current workspace

commands.name: $(beaker) Verify All
commands.tooltip: Run the full workspace verification including coverage tests and build

commands.name: $(tools) Run Task
commands.tooltip: Open the VS Code Run Task picker

commands.name: $(browser) Dashboards
commands.tooltip: Web (10001) + Grafana (10008) im integrierten Simple Browser öffnen

commands.name: $(play) Dev Stack
commands.tooltip: RUNBOOK §2: Infra → Seed → pnpm dev (Reihenfolge ist Pflicht)

commands.name: $(rocket) LT Stack
commands.tooltip: RUNBOOK §3: Lasttest-Stack hochfahren (Infra → Seed → API + Worker, je eigenes Terminal). Die Service-Terminals müssen offen bleiben.

commands.name: $(pulse) LT Ready
commands.tooltip: RUNBOOK §3: Prüft, ob API (10002) und Worker (10003) antworten. 'Spike Report' macht das automatisch vorweg.

commands.name: $(debug-stop) LT Stop
commands.tooltip: RUNBOOK §3: Prozesse auf Port 10002/10003 beenden (nach Port, nicht nach Prozessmuster)

commands.name: $(dashboard) Spike Report
commands.tooltip: RUNBOOK §4: Voller Lasttest mit Belegerhebung → artifacts/load-tests/<run-id>/ (dauert viele Minuten)

commands.name: $(graph) Analyze
commands.tooltip: RUNBOOK §5: Run-Verzeichnis auswerten — rein, ohne laufenden Stack

commands.name: $(database) DB Apply
commands.tooltip: RUNBOOK §7: db:push gegen die Ziel-DB + Guardrails

commands.name: $(bug) Debug All
commands.tooltip: RUNBOOK §8: Runtime-Env, Schema-Drift und buy_ticket-Contract prüfen

commands.name: $(git-merge) Merge hfts-dev1 → main
commands.tooltip: Checkout main, pull latest, and merge hfts-dev1 locally (no push)
commands.command: git checkout main && git pull && git merge hfts-dev1
